description: Beginner-friendly impact analytics tool for small nonprofits — track donations, programs, volunteers, and grant outcomes with guided explanations

pages.name: overview
pages.description: Main dashboard with tabbed sections and a friendly orientation panel for newcomers
components: Top bar with organization name, a workspace switcher dropdown, a fiscal-year selector, a help icon with a question mark, and a small avatar with the user's first name
Welcome strip greeting the user by name with a one-sentence 'here is what changed this week' summary and a dismissable 'Take the 2-minute tour' button
Horizontal tab bar (Overview, Donations, Programs, Volunteers, Grants) with the Overview tab active and a thin underline marking the active tab

Row of four impact tiles — Total raised this year, People served, Active volunteers, Programs running — each tile has a label, a big number, a plain-language comparison line ('that is 12 more than last month'), and a tiny trend arrow icon

Two-column lower section: left is a 'Where your funding came from' donut chart with a legend listing source categories and percentages, right is a 'Recent milestones' timeline with dated entries (icon, headline, one-sentence description)

pages.name: donations
pages.description: Donations tab focused on incoming gifts, with a beginner explainer and a sortable ledger
components: Same top bar and tab bar, with Donations active
Explainer callout card with an info icon, the heading 'What this page shows', a short paragraph defining recurring vs one-time gifts, and a 'Learn more' link

Filter and summary row — date-range picker, campaign dropdown, donor-type chips (Individual, Foundation, Corporate, Anonymous), and three inline summary numbers (total gifts, average gift, new donors)
Stacked area chart of giving over time with a toggle between Weekly and Monthly views and a small legend separating recurring from one-time gifts
Donations ledger table with columns Donor, Date, Amount, Campaign, Type, Acknowledgement status — each row has a follow-up action menu, and a pagination bar sits below the table

pages.name: programs
pages.description: Programs tab tracking outcomes for each initiative the nonprofit runs
components: Same top bar and tab bar, with Programs active
Page heading 'Programs' with a short subtitle and an 'Add a program' primary action button on the right
Grid of program cards (two per row) — each card has program name, one-sentence mission, progress bar toward an annual people-served goal, count vs goal, cost-per-outcome figure, and a status pill
Outcomes comparison panel — a horizontal bar chart ranking programs by people served this quarter with a toggle to switch the metric to Dollars spent or Hours contributed
Beginner glossary accordion at the bottom defining terms like 'outcome', 'output', 'cost per outcome', and 'logic model', each row expandable to a short plain-language definition

pages.name: volunteers
pages.description: Volunteers tab showing the people powering the work and how their hours are spent
components: Same top bar and tab bar, with Volunteers active
Summary band with three figures — Active volunteers, Hours logged this month, Retention rate — each with a plain-language helper line under the number
Hours heatmap calendar showing volunteer hours per day across the last three months, with a color-intensity legend and a hover tooltip description in the corner
Volunteer roster table listing volunteer name, role, hours this month, total hours, last shift date, and a contact icon, with a search input and a role filter above the table
Upcoming shifts panel — list of scheduled shifts with date, time window, program name, slots filled vs needed, and a 'Send reminder' link per row

pages.name: grants
pages.description: Grants tab tracking grant applications, reporting deadlines, and outcome reporting
components: Same top bar and tab bar, with Grants active
Pipeline strip showing five status columns (Researching, Drafting, Submitted, Awarded, Reporting) with a count and total dollar value per column
Upcoming deadlines list — each row shows funder name, deliverable (application or report), due date, days remaining as a chip, assigned teammate avatar, and a checkbox to mark complete
Awarded grants table with columns Funder, Award amount, Period, Restrictions, Spent to date (with an inline progress bar), and Next report due

Reporting helper panel with the heading 'Need to write a report?' and a numbered three-step checklist (Pull program outcomes, Match to funder priorities, Export a one-page summary) each step having a short helper sentence and a button

pages.name: getting-started
pages.description: Onboarding page that walks total beginners through setting up their analytics workspace
components: Slim top bar with organization name and a 'Skip setup' text link on the right
Progress header with the heading 'Set up your impact dashboard', a step counter (Step 2 of 5), and a thin progress bar

Vertical checklist of five setup tasks (Connect donation platform, Import donor list, Define programs, Invite team, Pick fiscal year) — each item has icon, title, one-line description, status pill, and action button

Side help card with the heading 'New to analytics?' containing a short reassuring paragraph, a bulleted list of three short articles (What is an outcome?, Why fiscal year matters, How we keep donor data safe), and a 'Chat with a human' button
